reader: existing ManagedSourceReader and owned _SourceDescriptor; no original API changes

admission.manifest: entire typed reviewed profile only; duplicate JSON rejected
admission.source: bounded regular single-link file; no symlink component; exact size/digest; identity readback includes source mtime/ctime
admission.snapshot: Linux memfd; write/grow/shrink/seal four seals; retained object/mode/uid/gid/nlink/size and complete actual proc-path SHA readback
admission.memfd_timestamp: failed writes can change timestamps; sealed byte proof uses object/size/seals/full digest

lifetime.public_use: creator process and thread; no reentry, closed/foreign/replaced descriptor refused
lifetime.path: borrowed /proc/creator_pid/fd/n only while owner retained; not a transferable approval
lifetime.release: after fixed Cargo leader wait and ordinary process group termination; no retry of reused FD integer
lifetime.shutdown_failure: bounded wait failure retains process+lease custody in caller and cannot be qualified

build.new_target: exclusive initially empty per invocation, outside upstream, no existing cache
build.override_refusal: all MOZJS_*; Cargo features/profile/target/build overrides; rustflags/wrappers/toolchain/incremental conflicts
build.upstream_semantics: MOZJS_ARCHIVE tries URL base first then path fallback; cached OUT_DIR archive can override env; fresh target required
